studio.headline: A personalised stamina plan — exercise, nutrition, and honest timelines.
studio.aboutTitle: We map exercise, food, and recovery to the body you actually have.
studio.aboutBody: The team is a mix of coaching, nutrition, and product thinking. What we share is a habit of starting with your answers — BMI, sleep, stress, and goals — then writing a plan you can follow without fake day-count promises.

traps.title: Generic Advice
traps.body: Borrowed gym tips that ignore your sleep, BMI, and actual week.

traps.title: Guaranteed Day Counts
traps.body: Nobody can promise a date for stamina. We give a 4–8 week range.

traps.title: No Visual Guidance
traps.body: A wall of text is easy to skip. Photos make the next session obvious.

traps.title: Ignoring Medical Context
traps.body: Screening flags belong in the plan — they are not a diagnosis.

traps.title: One-Size-Fits-All Diets
traps.body: Eat-more and limit grids follow your answers, not a celebrity plate.

home.solutionSub: The antidote to vague wellness advice
home.solutionHeadline: Generic advice missed it. We map it to
home.solutionBody: No passive PDF filler. Exercise photos, food visuals, BMI bands, and honest 4–8 week ranges.

legal.disclaimer: This report is for educational and lifestyle purposes only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Individual results vary. Consult a qualified healthcare provider before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have heart disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, or persistent sexual health concerns.
privacyBody: Stamina Booster collects information you provide in the questionnaire (name, age, body metrics, lifestyle answers) to generate your personalized report.
We use cookies for session management. Payment processing is handled by our payment provider when enabled; we do not store full card numbers.
PDFs may be stored temporarily on our servers or cloud storage to enable download links. You may request deletion by contacting support with your order reference.
We do not sell your health data. Analytics events are used to improve the product.
For questions: privacy@vitalitypath.example (replace with your domain).
